scope: Exact C2 integrated-quartic derivative perturbation plus one fixed analytic rotational background; shared binary nodes, endpoint derivative jets, physical-midpoint first derivatives and C3 coefficients. Sampling is not a continuous metric/curvature certificate. Planar rr source uses finite differences; ODE and far nonlinear graph errors remain unpaid. Each stage endpoint shooting defect is distributed through one physical-r cubic Hermite correction to Fr; its exact derivative corrects Frr. This is part of the finite map definition, not an exact ODE correction.

format.interpretation: Gamma-r exp(i theta)=sum real a_m exp(i m theta); z-h=sum c_m cos(m theta). Fr is the cubic Hermite interpolant of endpoint Fr,Frr plus the quartic bubble t^2(1-t)^2 matching its physical-midpoint value. F is the exact integral from the first endpoint; stored node positions are numerical evaluations only. Thus the model is piecewise quintic and exactly C2, without differentiating quantized point values. Duplicate raw-cell interface rows are byte-identical.

gauge: At deepest represented port the nonlinear mean-height perturbation is zero; mean is accumulated outward without resets. Exact fixed h_rot has cuff value zero; stored h_rot values are numerical primitive evaluations, used only for positions, not metric derivatives.
